# ScriptServerRayTrace

*Server*

Result of a ray trace from `entity.rayTraceBlock`, `entity.rayTraceEntity` or `world.rayTrace`: a hit block, a hit entity or a miss.

```js
const rayTrace = c.getPlayer().rayTraceBlock(5, false);

if (rayTrace.isBlock()) {
    c.getPlayer().send(c.getWorld().getBlock(rayTrace.getBlock()).getId());
}
```

## Methods

### isBlock {#isblock}

::: member

Checks if the ray trace hit a block

```js
c.getPlayer().rayTraceBlock(5, false).isBlock();
```

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — whether the ray hit a block

:::

### isEntity {#isentity}

::: member

Checks if the ray trace hit an entity

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — whether the ray hit an entity

:::

### isMissed {#ismissed}

::: member

Checks if the ray trace missed and hit nothing

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — whether the ray hit nothing

:::

### getEntity {#getentity}

::: member

Returns the entity hit by the ray trace, if any

**Returns** `ScriptServerEntity<?>` — the hit entity, or null if the ray did not hit an entity

:::

### getBlock {#getblock}

::: member

Returns the target of the block hit by the ray trace, if any

**Returns** [`ScriptVector`](/scripting/common/ScriptVector) — new vector with the position of the hit block, or null if the ray did not hit a block

:::

### getBlockSide {#getblockside}

::: member

Returns the side of the block that was hit by the ray trace

**Returns** [`String`](/scripting/js/String) — hit side of the block: `"up"`, `"down"`, `"north"`, `"south"`, `"west"` or `"east"`; null if the ray did not hit a block

:::

### getHitPosition {#gethitposition}

::: member

Returns the exact target where the ray trace hit

**Returns** [`ScriptVector`](/scripting/common/ScriptVector) — new vector with the exact point the ray hit, or its end if it missed

:::
